etl_logic: SUM(securities_trade.execution_vol) JOIN security_trading_snapshot ON security_trading_snapshot.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code WHERE securities_trade.market_id_code = 'DVX' AND securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date
